# KaTeX runtime assets

KaTeX 0.16.47 is vendored here for offline exercise previews. The runtime
module, auto-render helper, stylesheet, and font files are unmodified copies
from the KaTeX package. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE) for its MIT license.

The auto-render helper supports `$…$` and `$$…$$` in exercise text. Math
rendering is limited to the exercise interface and is configured with
`trust: false`.
